build_bert_tokenizer_legacy: build a BertTokenizerLegacy instance from a vocab file for BERT WordPiece tokenization
load_vocab_file: load a BERT vocab file into an ordered dictionary mapping tokens to integer IDs
tokenize_text_basic: tokenize text using BasicTokenizer with lowercasing, punctuation splitting, and accent stripping
tokenize_wordpiece: tokenize a text piece into word pieces using greedy longest-match-first WordPiece algorithm
build_inputs_special_tokens: build BERT sequence inputs with [CLS], [SEP] special tokens for single or paired sequences
